  "rationale": "The columns collectively cohere around a clear, data-inferable focus: overall passenger satisfaction synthesized from the existing per-aspect ratings. Segmentation variables (traveler_type, is_business_class) add actionable predictor structure for investigating who is satisfied and why. The set is dragged down by two generic/tangential additions — review_length (bare text length) and is_verified (metadata flag) — which are the mechanical grab-bag elements this test penalizes. The implied focus is clearly actionable: an analyst can rank aspects, compare segments, and target the lowest-rated driver.
